name: @aics/api
description: ONE BNPL AICS — NestJS API. Document ingestion, feature engineering, four-pillar scorecard and credit decisioning.

scripts.//start: Output nests under dist/src because rootDir spans both src/ and prisma/ — Prisma 7 emits the client as TypeScript source that must be compiled with the app.
scripts.//db:seed: Runs from compiled output, not tsx. tsx uses esbuild, which cannot emit emitDecoratorMetadata, so Nest silently fails to inject constructor params that are not explicitly @Inject-ed. Compiling with tsc is also what production runs.

dependencyNotes.prisma: A runtime dependency, not dev-only, so `prisma migrate deploy` can run from the release image. The Dockerfile prunes dev dependencies into the runtime layer; leaving the CLI in devDependencies made schema migration impossible from the very artifact being deployed.
